title: Federated User Behavior Modeling for Privacy-Preserving LLM Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2604.14833v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models have shown great success in recommender systems. However, the limited and sparse nature of user data often restricts the LLM's ability to effectively model behavior patterns. To address this, existing studies have explored cross-domain solutions by conducting Cross-Domain Recommendation tasks. But previous methods typically assume domains are overlapped and can be accessed readily. None of the LLM methods address the privacy-preserving issues in the CDR settings, that is, Privacy-Preserving Cross-Domain Recommendation. translated_title: 面向隐私保护大语言模型推荐的联邦用户行为建模
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在推荐系统中已取得巨大成功。然而，用户数据的有限性和稀疏性往往限制了LLM有效建模用户行为模式的能力。为解决这一问题，现有研究通过开展跨域推荐任务探索了跨域解决方案。但以往方法通常假设域之间存在重叠且可以随时访问。目前没有任何LLM方法能够解决跨域推荐（CDR）场景中的隐私保护问题，即隐私保护跨域推荐（PPCDR）。使用LLM开展非重叠的PPCDR极具挑战性，原因在于：1）无法跨域共享用户身份或行为数据，阻碍了有效的跨域对齐；2）跨域数据模态的异质性使知识整合变得复杂；3）将传统推荐模型的协同过滤信号与LLM相融合十分困难，因为它们运行在截然不同……
tldr: 本文提出一种联邦用户行为建模方法，在不跨域共享用户身份与行为数据的前提下，解决跨域对齐、模态异质性和协同过滤信号融合等难题，实现基于大语言模型的隐私保护跨域推荐。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes federated user behavior modeling to enable privacy-preserving cross-domain recommendation with LLMs, tackling cross-domain alignment, data modality heterogeneity, and collaborative filtering signal fusion without sharing user data across domains.
